_doc: Fairy type text (HoennB2's src/text/overrides_fairy.json and overrides_fairy_ui.json, the same words; b2tools/patches/fairy.py, fairy_ui.py, notes/FAIRY.md). PENDING: this needs two things patches/sinnoh_names.py's text_overrides() lacks (notes/FAIRY.md 'Text'): a label written '+Label' is a NEW line appended at the file's end (before its \\pad line), in this order, and a key 'res/<path>.json' merges its fields into that data file of pokebw2's sources (the item names and descriptions come from res/items/*/data.json through \\from{items.*}). Once sinnoh_names has both, move this file to data/text_overrides/fairy.json. Lines: type 17 'Fairy' (type_names), moves 560-565 (move_names, move_names_upper, btl_main_13 = descriptions, 0016 = 'X used Y!' lines 1680-1697: move * 3 + 0/1/2), items 113/114 (Pixie Plate, Fairy Gem), the Pokedex search's type 17 label (zknsearch_main line 77, blank in Black 2: fairy_ui).

btl_main_13.+BtlMain13_Text_FairyWind: The user stirs up a fairy wind and\nstrikes the target with it.
btl_main_13.+BtlMain13_Text_DisarmingVoice: Letting out a charming cry, the user does\nemotional damage to opposing Pokémon.\nThis attack never misses.
btl_main_13.+BtlMain13_Text_DrainingKiss: The user steals the target's HP with a\nkiss. The user's HP is restored by over\nhalf of the damage taken by the target.
btl_main_13.+BtlMain13_Text_DazzlingGleam: The user damages opposing Pokémon by\nemitting a powerful flash.
btl_main_13.+BtlMain13_Text_PlayRough: The user plays rough with the target\nand attacks it. This may also lower the\ntarget's Attack stat.
btl_main_13.+BtlMain13_Text_Moonblast: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user\nattacks the target. This may also lower\nthe target's Sp. Atk stat.

res/items/unused_113/data.json.name: Pixie Plate
res/items/unused_113/data.json.description:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a stone tablet that boosts the
power of Fairy-type moves.

res/items/unused_114/data.json.name: Fairy Gem
res/items/unused_114/data.json.description:
A gem with an essence of the fey. When
held, it strengthens the power of a
Fairy-type move only once.
